# Ferry timetable

The 07:40 sailing is the only one that connects with the bus, and it does
not run on Sundays.

| Departure | Arrival | Days      |
| --------- | ------- | --------- |
| 07:40     | 08:15   | Mon–Sat   |
| 12:10     | 12:45   | Daily     |
| 18:55     | 19:30   | Mon–Fri   |

Fares are cash only. See [the operator](https://example.invalid/ferry).
